meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Framework for computational fluid dynamics simulations using Python. Use when running fluid dynamics simulations including Navier-Stokes equations (2D/3D), shallow water equations, stratified flows, or when analyzing turbulence, vortex dynamics, or geophysical flows. Provides pseudospectral methods with FFT, HPC support, and comprehensive output analysis.

copy.tagline: 用Python运行流体动力学模拟
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行CFD模拟或研究流体力学
copy.tagline_en: Run fluid dynamics simulations with Python
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run CFD simulations or study fluid mechanics

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你用 Python 编写和运行流体动力学模拟，包括 2D/3D 纳维-斯托克斯方程、浅水方程、分层流等。它会生成参数配置、执行模拟，并输出速度场、涡量、能谱等结果。
howto.when: 当你要求进行流体动力学模拟，例如研究湍流、涡旋动力学或地球物理流时触发。

say.text: 用 fluidsim 的 ns2d.strat 求解器模拟分层流，设置 N=2。
say.note: Claude 会配置参数并执行模拟。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write and run computational fluid dynamics simulations in Python, including 2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, and stratified flows. It generates parameter configurations, executes simulations, and outputs results like velocity, vorticity, and spectra.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request fluid dynamics simulations, such as studying turbulence, vortex dynamics, or geophysical flows.

say_en.text: Help me simulate 2D turbulence with fluidsim, grid 256x256, viscosity 1e-3.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and run the simulation code.

say_en.text: Use fluidsim's ns2d.strat solver to simulate stratified flow with N=2.
say_en.note: Claude will configure parameters and execute the simulation.
